text.title: Ops Metrics Basics Worked Example
text.summary: Worked reference material for the rules in 01-core-rules.xml. Data sources, lean tracking stack options, target-setting approach, alert thresholds, and review cadence for operators. Precise formulas for all essential SaaS metrics and six common tracking mistakes with fixes.

example.title: Stack options by scale
example.note: Stack options by scale: smallest — Stripe + Google Sheets + Looker Studio; mid — Stripe + PostHog free tier + Looker Studio; largest pre-warehouse — Stripe + Mixpanel/Amplitude + Metabase.

example.title: Four alert conditions
example.note: Configure alerts for four conditions: revenue drop greater than 20% week-over-week (investigate immediately), churn rate above threshold (review immediately), zero sales for 24+ hours (check payment system health), CAC above target (review ad spend).

section.title: Review cadence

example.title: Four review frequencies
example.note: Four frequencies: Daily pulse check (2 minutes — revenue and zero-sales alert); weekly performance review (30 minutes — full metrics table, went-well, needs-attention, next-week actions); monthly deep analysis (2 hours — cohort trends, CAC/LTV reconciliation, churn diagnosis); quarterly strategy review (half day — target reset, OKR alignment).

section.reference: Weekly review template with metrics table and action items

example.title: Locked formulas for the essential SaaS metrics
example.note: MRR = sum of all monthly recurring revenue. ARR = MRR × 12. Churn rate = customers lost in period / customers at start of period. LTV = ARPU / churn rate (in months). CAC = total marketing spend / new customers acquired. LTV:CAC ratio = LTV / CAC (target above 3:1, healthy above 5:1). ARPU = total revenue / total active customers. Net revenue retention = (starting MRR + expansion MRR - churn MRR) / starting MRR (target above 100%).
